chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from someone else from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu al-Abbas from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who travels and with him is a slave girl during the month of Ramadan, can he have intercourse with her? He said: Yes.

key_terms.يَقَعُ عَلَيْهَا: he falls upon her / has intercourse with her
key_terms.يُسَافِرُ: travels (referring to the state of safar)

ai.seo_question: Can a man have intercourse with his slave girl during the day of Ramadan while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the permissibility of sexual intercourse with a slave girl during the daylight hours of Ramadan for a traveling man, highlighting the distinct legal status of slaves compared to free women. Scholars note that while fasting prohibits eating and drinking, the prohibition on sexual relations generally applies to wives; for slave girls, the ruling is often interpreted as permissible unless specific conditions of ownership or travel status invoke different juristic opinions. This narration underscores the flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding the rights of slaves during the holy month.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from someone else, from Aban Bin Usman, from Abu Al Abbas,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the man who travels and with his is a slave girl, during a Month of Ramazan. Can he fall upon her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 4. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from more than one person from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from abu al-‘Abbas who has said the following: “This is about a man who experiences sexual relation with a slave-girl while on a journey in the month of Ramadan. Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is not harmful.’”
